title: R6C fixed cycle-activation factor graph

program_alignment.central_question: Can the public D4 record be represented by an exact truth-free fixed factor graph before belief propagation is attempted?
program_alignment.upstream_evidence: R6B rejects preprocessing one direct parity-scope list from the public observation
program_alignment.downstream_gate: a local connectivity-auxiliary compression may be attempted only after this fixed finite-graph control is exact

question.research_question: Does a fixed catalog of cycle-activation factors over latent edge variables, boundary edges, and public charge bits reproduce the exact D4 likelihood?
question.smallest_claim: Exactness on the complete primitive fixture and the registered paper-L2 ambiguity records; no polynomial factor-count or BP claim.
question.G0: direct observation-only scope preprocessing, rejected by R6B
question.G1: one fixed activation factor for each homologically trivial simple cycle and charge colour
question.G2: local connectivity auxiliaries, deferred until G1 exactness is verified

model.activation: a catalog cycle is active iff every cycle edge is selected and every other edge incident to its vertices is unselected
model.factor_value: inactive -> 1; active and observed colour parity even -> 2; active and parity odd -> 0
model.local_weight: flux/degree support times 2^{-number of measured degree-two vertices}
model.terminal: nontrivial winding components remain terminal and receive no ordinary O2 likelihood
model.truth_boundary: factor specifications are built from fixed lattice geometry only; activation depends on latent edge variables inside the factor, not simulator truth supplied as decoder input

matrix.primitive_complete: all 49855 compatible pairs from the frozen primitive-size-2 R4.2 catalog
matrix.paper_ambiguity: all stored example candidate masks from every R6B ambiguous public record, with even-charge and one-bit parity-violation probes
catalogs: primitive periodic size=2 full trivial-cycle catalog
matrix.budget: under ten CPU minutes and 2 GiB; zero decoder-performance samples

claim_boundary: G1 exactness establishes a fixed finite-graph representation only. It does not establish polynomial scaling, local bounded arity, BP convergence, logical performance, threshold, or fault tolerance.
